Card.Name: Background Group Policy Refresh
Card.Description: Windows normally refreshes Group Policy in the background while the system is being used. This policy lets the device wait until logoff before applying those updates.
Card.FriendlyDescription: Windows normally refreshes Group Policy in the background while the system is being used. This policy lets the device wait until logoff before applying those updates.
Card.WhatWeKnowSummary: Claim: Windows normally refreshes Group Policy in the background while the system is being used. This policy lets the device wait until logoff before applying those updates.
